first_pass.why: The X on the slide-up panels is fine, but the same X in the corner of a chat means something else and I can't tell from the picture whether it ends incognito or closes and loses my chat.
first_pass.solution: Put a word next to the chat-corner X, like 'Exit incognito', or keep the ghost there and show it as switched on, so the plain X only ever means close this panel.

test_cases.what_to_try: On the chat screen press the ghost at the top right. Type one short word in the chat box (don't send it). Then press the X at the top right. Did your chat close and lose the word, or did something else happen? Was it what you expected?
test_cases.real_if: you lost something, or you could not tell what the X did
test_cases.not_real_if: it did what you expected and you could tell what happened
test_cases.what_happened: I pressed the ghost. It got an 'Incognito chat' title at the top, a big ghost in the middle, and an X where the ghost had been. The phone was slow, so for a moment it flipped back and forth, but in the end I was in incognito with my word 'ello' in the box (the phone dropped the 'h'). Then I pressed the X. It took me straight back to the normal 'Coffee and Claude time?' chat, with the ghost back in the corner. My word was still in the box. Nothing was closed or thrown away, it just switched incognito off. Then I cleared the word. I got to the end of it fine. The only thing I didn't know until I tried it was what the X would do.

fg1.same_expectation_why: They're all in the same corner, so maybe it's one on/off switch - but a ghost and an X don't look like the same switch to me; the X looks like 'close'.
fg1.affects_navigation: Yes - if the X is really 'turn incognito off' I'd never guess that; I'd avoid it because X everywhere else in the app closes a panel, and I'd worry about losing my chat.

first_pass.why: The ghost turning into a plain X doesn't read as the same switch. An X means close to me, and on the slide-up panels in this app it does mean close.
first_pass.solution: Keep the ghost there and make it look switched on (filled, highlighted, or with a word like 'Incognito on') instead of swapping it for an X.

test_cases.what_to_try: Press the ghost at the top right of the chat screen, look at what replaces it, then press that. After trying it, does the ghost and the X read to you as one on/off switch?
test_cases.real_if: after trying it you still do not read them as one switch, or it did something you did not expect
test_cases.not_real_if: trying it makes the switch obvious
test_cases.what_happened: I pressed the ghost. The ghost went away, an X took its place, and the screen said 'Incognito chat' with the explanation in the middle. I pressed the X and it took me back to the ordinary chat with the ghost back in the corner. My typed word was still there. So after one go, yes, I can see it's an on/off switch: ghost to go in, X to come out, same corner. What I expected didn't match, though. I was afraid the X would close and lose my chat, and it didn't. The X is still the same 'close' X the pop-up panels use, so I only knew it was a switch because I tried it. The first time, I'd still hesitate.
